modelNotes: Rebounds Board 1.0 uses season rebounds, last 5 rebounds, last 10 rebounds, expected minutes, minutes confidence, position role, and recent rebound trend.
Rebounds Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent rebound rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Antetokounmpo is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to right groin tendinitis.
injury.detail: The fact that Antetokounmpo is probable suggests the star forward should have a decent chance to suit up Friday. He's been playing at a high level lately, recording four consecutive double-doubles and averaging 28.6 points, 12.9 rebounds, 5.3 assists and 1.6 blocks per game since the beginning of November.

injury.shortComment: Embiid (illness) is questionable for Friday's game against the Pacers.
injury.detail: Embiid has missed the team's last two games due to an illness, but it seems the star big man could return as soon as Friday -- or at least it sounds as if he has a chance to do so. Embiid has been turning things around of late, scoring at least 20 points in four games in a row and averaging 27.3 points, 8.0 rebounds, 5.0 assists and a combined 2.8 steals-plus-blocks per game over that stretch.

injury.shortComment: Hayes (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Nuggets.
injury.detail: Hayes could miss a second straight game due to a left knee strain. If he is unavailable, Mo Bamba figures to see an expanded role.

injury.shortComment: Drummond (head) is questionable for Friday's game against the Heat.
injury.detail: Drummond exited Wednesday's win over the Cavaliers due to a head injury, and a decision on his availability Friday will be made closer to the 7 p.m. ET tipoff. Drummond adds depth at center behind Karl-Anthony Towns, so if he doesn't play, look for Mohamed Diawara and James Wiseman to see an uptick in playing time.

injury.shortComment: Edey (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Timberwolves.
injury.detail: Edey didn't return to Wednesday's 115-97 win over the Clippers, finishing with seven points (3-4 FG, 1-1 FT), four rebounds, two assists and two blocks across nine minutes. Taylor Hendricks could be in line for a bigger role in the frontcourt Friday, as Isaiah Stewart (hip) is questionable as well.

injury.shortComment: Ball (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
injury.detail: Ball exited Wednesday's game against the Thunder and finished with 19 points (7-18 FG, 5-9 3Pt), seven rebounds, eight assists and one steal in 29 minutes. If he's unable to suit up Friday, Bones Hyland and Terrence Shannon would be in line to see more playing time in the backcourt. That would be a huge downgrade for a Minnesota team that's already missing two key backcourt pieces in Anthony Edwards (knee) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles).

injury.shortComment: Oubre is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers due to a right hand laceration.
injury.detail: Oubre has been performing at a high level of late, scoring at least 15 points in six straight contests, but he could be forced to miss time due to a right hand injury. If he is out, Quenton Jackson could see extra minutes.

injury.shortComment: Stewart is questionable for Friday's game against the Timberwolves due to right hip soreness.
injury.detail: Stewart could miss Friday's game, and if so, it'd be a huge blow for the Grizzlies since Zach Edey (ankle) is also questionable. If both players are out, Taylor Hendricks would be the next in line to see heavy minutes at center. Stewart is averaging 10.6 points, 3.3 rebounds and 0.9 assists per game this season.

injury.shortComment: Fox (shin) is questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.
injury.detail: Fox could miss a third straight game due to a right shin contusion. If he is unavailable, Jordan McLaughlin is expected to retain an expanded role.

injury.shortComment: Wiggins is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to a right ankle sprain.
injury.detail: Wiggins has been added to the injury report and could miss a game for the first time this season. The veteran forward hasn't started a game since Nov. 5 and is averaging just 9.8 points per game when deployed with the second unit. His fantasy appeal won't be very high if he stays in this bench role.

injury.shortComment: McConnell (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
injury.detail: McConnell has missed the Pacers' last two games due to left hamstring soreness, and the questionable tag suggests the veteran floor general could be an option Friday. He's not expected to have a big role in most fantasy lineups, though, as he's averaging just 7.0 points, 4.3 assists, and 2.3 rebounds per game in his seven outings off the bench this season.

injury.shortComment: Martin is questionable for Friday's game against the Nets due to left knee soreness.
injury.detail: A decision on Martin's availability will be made closer to Friday's 7:30 p.m. tip-off, but his status shouldn't cause a big impact in most fantasy formats. He's averaging just 0.8 points and 2.2 rebounds on 12.2 minutes per game off the bench over his last five appearances.

injury.shortComment: Nance (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
injury.detail: Nance didn't return to Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle, and it remains to be seen whether the big man will be able to suit up Friday. He shouldn't cause a massive impact in most fantasy lineups with his absence, as Nance is averaging just 4.2 points and 2.2 rebounds per game in 17 appearances off the bench this season.

injury.shortComment: McBride (groin) is questionable for Friday's game against the Heat.
injury.detail: McBride has missed the Knicks' previous two games. Even if he's cleared to return Friday, he wouldn't carry a ton of fantasy appeal. He's averaging just 6.8 points per game this season.

injury.shortComment: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.
injury.detail: Reese dropped a 15-point, 15-rebound double-double in the Squadron's win over the Mexico City Capitanes on Saturday and will return to the parent club ahead of its game Monday. Through five regular-season appearances at the NBA level this season, the big man is averaging 1.2 points and 1.0 rebounds in 5.4 minutes per tilt.
